frequency_question: How often do successful transboundary water negotiations result in a formal signed treaty or MOU satisfying written criteria within the designated timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes any formal bilateral water allocation or management treaty negotiated to replace an expiring predecessor. Excludes informal talks, unilateral declarations, and domestic water agreements.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and renewals
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase II agreement
Columbia River Treaty renegotiation framework agreements

provenance_note: 6 cases named, 7 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.2x)
coverage_note: 6 named representative cases; estimated total population of major expiring water treaties is roughly 15 globally.
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively list minor bilateral basin agreements in smaller European or Asian sub-regions.
skeleton: Global transboundary water renewal events since 1975 where formal successor instruments were attempted.
multiplier: 6 observed major negotiations / 7 attempted major renewals yielding formal successor instruments
validity_reason: Bilateral transboundary water treaty norms and diplomatic standards for formalizing agreements remain stable over 5-to-10 year horizons.
